endpoints.title: Get affiliates
endpoints.description: Get all of your account's affiliates. Optionally filter by referral source or branch.

endpoints.title: Get all customers
endpoints.description: Get a list of all customers ordered by name. Optionally, you can filter them based on the job service date associated with each customer's opportunities. When filtered using service date(s), by default the opportunity info is included, to exclude it set IncludeOpportunityInfo = False.

endpoints.title: Get arrival windows
endpoints.description: Get all the arrival windows that are configured for your company, including their description, start time, and end time.

endpoints.title: Get audit activity for opportunity
endpoints.description: Get audit activity for opportunity

endpoints.title: Get bad lead reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's bad lead reasons.

endpoints.title: Get branches
endpoints.description: Get all your company branches, alongside their dispatch location, and phone number.

endpoints.title: Get cancellation reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's job cancellation reasons.

endpoints.title: Get crew member by Id
endpoints.description: Get the crew member details of one of the configured members in your account, including their contact information, role, branch, and compensation settings.

endpoints.title: Get crew members
endpoints.description: Get all crew members configured in your account, including their contact information, role, branch, and compensation settings.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filter by status: Active or Inactive

endpoints.title: Get customer by Id
endpoints.description: Get single customer by Id

endpoints.title: Get jobs by crew member id
endpoints.description: Retrieve jobs associated with a specific crew member, filtered by service date.

endpoints.title: Get jobs by opportunityId
endpoints.description: Get jobs by Opportunity Id

endpoints.title: Get lead by Id
endpoints.description: Get single lead by Id

endpoints.title: Get leads
endpoints.description: Retrieves leads created within a time range. By default, only New and In Progress leads are returned, but Lost and Bad Leads can be included through query parameters.

endpoints.title: Get lost lead/opportunity reasons
endpoints.description: Get all of your company's lost lead/opportunity reasons.

endpoints.title: Get move sizes
endpoints.description: Get all the move sizes that are stored in your company, alongside their description, cubic feet, and weight.

endpoints.title: Get opportunities by customer Id
endpoints.description: Get opportunities by customer Id

endpoints.title: Get opportunity details
endpoints.description: Get detailed information about an opportunity

parameters.name: IncludeJobAddresses
parameters.description: List of job’s addresses/stops, returned in the order they were stored going from Origin, to Destination.

endpoints.title: Get referral sources
endpoints.description: Get all of your account’s referral sources, with the option to retrieve all of them or only your public ones (users on public lead forms you might have embedded on your website). If desired, you can also include your active lead providers in the response.

endpoints.title: Get service types
endpoints.description: Get all your enabled service types, both system and custom ones.

endpoints.title: Get statuses
endpoints.description: Get statuses

endpoints.title: Get storage accounts by customer Id
endpoints.description: Get storage accounts by customer Id

endpoints.title: Get tariffs
endpoints.description: Get all the tariffs within your company, with the option to include disabled tariffs or not.

parameters.name: IncludeTechMate
parameters.description: Include external tariffs created on TechMate in the response.

endpoints.title: Get users
endpoints.description: Get all the office users in your company, with all their key descriptive attributes such as title and role. Crew members are not included.
